message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on facts. Facts: On Aug 15 2015, 1:20 am, defendant Zhang (张某某) rode as passenger in car driven by Li (李某某). They were on a road near KTV. A traffic accident occurred causing one death. Then Li drove away (hit-and-run). At 3 am, Zhang was summoned to police, and during questioning, he gave false statements to cover up Li's traffic accident and escape. So Zhang's acts: He was a participant? He was passenger, not driver. He may be liable for traffic accident? Usually driver is responsible. However, as passenger, he may be charged with aiding and abetting hit-and-run? He gave false statements, i.e., providing false testimony, obstruction of justice, or "providing false statements to police" (伪证罪). Also "包庇" (concealing a crime) maybe "帮助逃逸" (helping the driver escape). The crime of "逃逸" is hit-and-run, but the driver is Li. Zhang's act of helping Li escape (by not reporting, maybe providing false statements) could be "包庇逃逸" which is "帮助逃逸罪" (helping a traffic accident offender escape). In Chinese criminal law, there is a crime "帮助交通肇事后逃逸罪" (Article 133 of Criminal Law). Also "伪证罪" (providing false statements to police). The fact says: "作虚假证明包庇李某某交通肇事后逃逸的犯罪事实". So the crime is "包庇" (concealing) and "提供虚假证明" (false statement). In examples, they used "窝藏、包庇" for similar. So answer likely: [罪名]窝藏、包庇;伪证? In examples, they used "窝藏、包庇" for first case. That case: "张某某明知其男友持刀...仍帮助...并随...逃匿". They labeled "窝藏、包庇". So here similar: Zhang helped Li escape and gave false statements. So "窝藏、包庇". Also maybe "交通肇事致人死亡"? But Zhang not driver. So not. So answer: [罪名]窝藏、包庇<eoa>.
